'''Walter Cowart Hidden Celebration''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Walter Cowart]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-1252">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1252 Hidden Celebration], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 17 November 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/1252/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/1252/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018222642/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1252/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Walter Cowart]]
* '''Published:''' 17 November 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hidden Celebration''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HB Cowart LS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits CC2/1 Site from SE, CCLeias'Hut: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Set up your guys on Cloud City and get cards back with Celebration.You don't ever intend on flipping which is sort of an advantage.

== Original post ==

'''Hidden Celebration'''
* '''Author:''' Walter "Walter" Cowart
* '''Published:''' November 17, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Set up your guys on Cloud City and get cards back with Celebration.You don't ever intend on flipping which is sort of an advantage.

=== Strategy ===

This deck is fairly simple to play and has proven Quite Popular and deadly.  I like the Cloud City theme(rather than the Tatooine version) the best,there are way more advantages.For one thing there's no exterior sites(e.g.no walkers), plus Path of Least Resistance is way stronger than Nabrun throw in Insurrection and you are hurting their transporters while yours are still as deadly.  You don't want to even try to fight in space so just hook-up and relax as you keep retrieving those canceled claws with Yoxgit.

vs.Hunt Down. Visage is an advantage to you and beating up on Vader and his pals shouldn't be that much of a problem.

Anything else shouldn't be a problem.

Enjoy Walter Cowart
